systems.country_label: eRITA Services: Birth and Death System, Marriage and Divorce Management System, Trustees Management System
systems.tiers: Public online portal with account login: new applications for birth and death registration, exchange of old certificates for new, and verification of birth and death certificates; marriage and divorce services also listed

note: RITA's service page lists what the public can apply for online; it describes a portal for applications and verification and says nothing of how or where a registration office makes the record, so no fact is taken for the civil class.
